manifest.title: Zero velocity isn’t zero acceleration.
manifest.summary: Two balls in side-by-side lanes: one tossed upward, one released at the top. Compare velocity and acceleration arrows.
assumptions: No air resistance, the same gravity for both balls, up is positive.
manifest.description: A tossed ball and a ball held at the apex height by a gate are shown. The gate opens at the top and both fall together. Arrows show velocity and acceleration.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. At top jumps to the shared release.
